baseline_models.focus_anchor: The doubled kh-l-q, the seven heavens described as tabaqan, and the paired exclusions of tafawut and futur.
baseline_models.mechanism: Creation is presented as measured construction: distinct superposed parts correspond at their interfaces, so the diagnostic failures would be disproportion, spacing mismatch, or an open seam.

activation_trace.role: Measuring a thing before action makes both the creating verb and the created order carry a specification-and-fit function.
The exact number seven supplies bounded plurality rather than an undifferentiated sky.
Layers placed one above another supply the spatial architecture whose interfaces are inspected.
One thing corresponding to another turns layering into fitted agreement, not mere stacking.
Distance or disproportion between two things supplies the mismatch explicitly denied of the construction.
Opening and splitting provide the concrete failure mode sought at a layer boundary.

changed_reading.before: The ayah generally praises a flawless sky.
changed_reading.after: The ayah describes a plural, measured assembly whose matching interfaces can be audited for spacing error, disproportion, and open seams.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence ma tara, fa-irji al-basar, hal tara repeats seeing around an imperative to return the faculty of sight.
baseline_models.mechanism: The negative claim is made inspectable: an initial observation is followed by a commanded rerun and a specified anomaly search, so sight functions as an iterative test rather than a single admiring glance.

activation_trace.role: Seeing by eye or insight brackets the procedure with an observation and a renewed question.
Returning something to its prior task converts looking into a repeatable pass.
The seeing faculty is the instrument explicitly sent back over the evidence.
Heart-level discernment keeps the audit from being limited to raw optical detection.
A fissure is the concrete anomaly against which the returned inspection is run.

changed_reading.before: The verse tells the hearer to admire what is visible.
changed_reading.after: The verse stages a reproducible challenge: inspect, return the instrument, and actively try to falsify the claim by locating a rupture.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction is uniquely called khalq al-Rahman precisely where disparity and rupture are denied.
baseline_models.mechanism: The divine name gives structural integrity a relational register: measured completeness leaves no part abandoned across a gap, so coherence can be read as an effect of encompassing care as well as technical perfection.

activation_trace.role: Mercy and tenderness name the maker at the point where the mechanism interprets integrity as non-neglect.
Complete formation and balanced appearance supply the coherent object through which care becomes perceptible.
A gap between two things supplies the image of separation that encompassing care excludes.
A split would materialize failed containment; its absence lets care register as maintained wholeness.

changed_reading.before: Cosmic perfection demonstrates abstract divine competence.
changed_reading.after: The gapless order also renders al-Rahman's care materially: its parts are formed, joined, and not left to separate.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding declaration of unrestricted capability activates both power-to-effect and measured deliberation, tightening the baseline from passive regularity into an executed specification backed by sovereignty.

activation_trace.role: Effective capability supplies the force by which the measured design can actually be realized and maintained.
Ordering an affair through measure and consideration sharpens creation into deliberate specification.
Measured creating receives the context's combined capability-and-planning charge.
Corresponding layers are the visible result of the specification.

structural_cues: 67:1 places dominion and capability before the creation sequence of 67:2-3.
The focus ayah repeats kh-l-q, allowing capability to govern both act and product.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies dominion, effective power, measured planning, and fitted layers; I infer an arrow from sovereign capacity to reliable specification, while the live alternative is that qadir marks power without detailing design method.

changed_reading.before: The layers happen to display proportion.
changed_reading.after: Their proportion is an executed and continuously enforceable specification of the sovereign creator.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding purpose of testing humans turns the focus ayah's inspection into a two-sided trial: sight probes the construction, but the commanded response also reveals the observer's own disposition and quality of attention.

activation_trace.role: A test that makes a condition manifest relocates part of the diagnostic burden from the sky to the human inspector.
Repeated seeing becomes the action through which the observer's response can be disclosed.
The command to return prevents a superficial first response from completing the trial.

structural_cues: 67:2 states a testing purpose immediately before 67:3 commands inspection.
The focus ayah uses both an imperative and an interrogative rather than merely asserting perfection.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a human test followed by a commanded visual procedure; I infer that the procedure can enact that test upon the observer, while the alternative is that 67:2 concerns deeds and 67:3 only supplies external evidence.

changed_reading.before: Only the cosmic object is placed under examination.
changed_reading.after: The examination simultaneously discloses whether the observer will look again, reason carefully, and accept what the search yields.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah expands one returned look into repeated passes whose eventual failure is borne by the inspecting faculty: the object remains coherent while sight turns back repelled and depleted.

activation_trace.role: Return and reiteration after a first pass make the focus command an explicitly repeated stress test.
Turning a thing back from its face gives the returning gaze a reversal rather than a discovered defect.
Sight becoming dim and exhausted locates test failure in the instrument.
Depleted force sets the endpoint of repeated inspection without supplying a fissure.
The focus command is the first return that the next ayah multiplies.
The eye is the finite test instrument contrasted with the stable construction.

structural_cues: 67:4 immediately repeats both irji and al-basar from the focus ayah.
The sequence ends with predicates of the gaze, not with any predicate of damage in the heavens.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repetition, reversal, repelled sight, and exhausted force; I infer an asymmetry in which the searcher reaches a limit before the searched order does, while the alternative is simple rhetorical emphasis on perfection.

changed_reading.before: A second glance confirms the first impression.
changed_reading.after: An open-ended anomaly search exhausts the finite observer and thereby distinguishes failure of detection from failure of the constructed order.

context_deltas.mechanism: The nearest heaven is immediately assigned simultaneous display and defensive functions, changing tabaqan from inert superposition into differentiated architecture in which at least one layer performs multiple coordinated jobs.

activation_trace.role: Making beauty visible gives the nearest layer a perceptual display function.
Rendering a thing into a state supplies purposeful assignment rather than accidental appearance.
Repelling and defending supplies the same visible elements with a boundary-protection role.
The layered architecture is revised from pure geometry into a stack of potentially differentiated functions.

structural_cues: 67:5 singles out al-sama al-dunya, identifying one member within the plurality of heavens.
The same lamps are first ornament and then projectiles, joining visibility to boundary action.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a nearest heaven, visible adornment, assigned transformation, and repulsion; I infer that these are coordinated layer functions, while the alternative is that 67:5 describes a local feature without characterizing the seven-layer system.

changed_reading.before: The seven layers are flawless because their shapes line up.
changed_reading.after: Their fit can also be functional: a differentiated layer remains coherent while serving display and protective boundary roles at once.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later scene of boiling and near-tearing prevents no tafawut from collapsing into placid sameness: intense motion and threatened separation can belong to a governed creation, while futur names an actual uncontrolled breach.

activation_trace.role: Boiling and surging supply severe internal motion against which static perfection is revised.
Near-severance makes threatened tearing visible without yet equating violent stress with a completed fissure.
Denied disproportion is narrowed from all difference or motion to incoherent mismatch.
The actual opening sought in the focus remains distinct from a system under violent strain.

structural_cues: 67:7-8 pairs audible and kinetic turbulence with an almost, rather than completed, tearing apart.
The focus negates tafawut before asking specifically for futur, distinguishing broad mismatch from a concrete rupture.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies surging and near-severance after the denial of disparity and fissure; I infer that coherence can survive governed stress, while the live alternative is a simple contrast between ordered heavens and the punitive scene rather than one general account of integrity.

changed_reading.before: Flawlessness means immobility, uniformity, and absence of force.
changed_reading.after: Flawlessness means no uncontrolled mismatch or completed breach; differentiated and even violently dynamic states need not negate order.

context_deltas.mechanism: The creator's access to the minute, hidden, and inward bounds the authority of the human visual test: the invitation to inspect is genuine, but ocular non-detection is not presented as exhaustive knowledge independent of the maker.

activation_trace.role: Smallness, subtlety, and hiddenness supply a scale and interiority beyond ordinary surface inspection.
Knowledge of inward reality supplies the creator-side access that human sight lacks.
Eye-and-insight remain valid evidence channels but are now explicitly finite ones.
The maker of the inspected object anchors the superior inward knowledge assigned by context.

structural_cues: 67:13 contrasts concealed and public speech and names what is within breasts.
67:14 asks whether the one who created would not know, directly linking creating and knowing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies hidden interiors, subtlety, inward knowledge, and the creator question; I infer that these qualify the epistemic reach of sight, while the alternative is that 67:13-14 concerns moral omniscience without commenting on the cosmic inspection.

changed_reading.before: The absence of a visible defect is a self-sufficient ocular proof.
changed_reading.after: The visual challenge is public and repeatable evidence nested within the creator's finer knowledge of hidden structure, not a claim that human sight is omniscient.

context_deltas.mechanism: Birds maintain ordered flight through alternating extension and contraction because al-Rahman holds them; this supplies a live model for cosmic coherence as sustained coordination, not merely a sealed object completed in the past.

activation_trace.role: Alignment on an even line supplies an ordered extended state.
Contraction after extension supplies articulated alternation within that order.
Holding and restraining supply the continuous support that prevents alternating motion from becoming collapse.
Mercy names the holder, directly linking sustained coordination back to khalq al-Rahman.
Correspondence between parts is strengthened into a maintained relation under motion.
The focus divine name receives the context's explicit holding function.

structural_cues: 67:19 repeats seeing, al-Rahman, and sight-language from the focus complex.
Spreading and folding are coordinated opposites joined by the claim that only al-Rahman holds the birds.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies aligned extension, contraction, holding, and the repeated name al-Rahman; I infer an analogy from held flight to maintained cosmic fit, while the alternative is that bird flight is a separate sign with no mechanical bearing on the layers.

changed_reading.before: Gaplessness is a static property fixed at the moment of construction.
changed_reading.after: Gaplessness can be continuously sustained coordination: parts extend, contract, and remain fitted because al-Rahman's care actively holds the order.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah later places human sight among faculties made for the human creature, turning the focus procedure into an internal audit: one created instrument is commanded to examine another created structure.

activation_trace.role: Bringing the human creature into existence places the observer inside the same created order being inspected.
The explicitly supplied faculty of eyesight becomes an instrument whose provenance is not independent of its maker.
The commanded instrument in the focus is identified by context as itself bestowed and created.
Created cosmos and created observer become two products participating in one evidentiary circuit.

structural_cues: 67:23 joins human origination with the making of hearing, sights, and hearts.
The focus does not merely mention a view; it directly commands al-basar as an operative faculty.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies human origination and bestowed sights; I infer a self-auditing circuit in which a created faculty tests created structure, while the alternative is that 67:23 only grounds gratitude and does not qualify the earlier test.

changed_reading.before: An autonomous observer stands outside creation and judges it.
changed_reading.after: A created and therefore finite faculty is invited to audit fellow creation, making the procedure both evidentiary and humbling.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated uses of r-a-y across the surah move from observing a sign, to confronting a realized outcome, to counterfactual interrogation; this confirms that the focus's doubled tara is a disciplined reasoning operation as well as optical scanning.

activation_trace.role: Eye-and-insight direct observation applies the focus procedure to birds in flight.
Confronted seeing supplies a consequential mode in which what was disputed becomes present.
The ara-aytakum form activates attention and inquiry rather than requiring a currently visible object.
A second counterfactual inquiry confirms seeing as reasoning through dependence and possible loss.
The focus's two sight verbs become the opening instance of this broader perceptual and interrogative discipline.

structural_cues: The focus itself combines negation, imperative return, and a hal question around the same seeing root.
Later occurrences shift in order from direct observation to realized confrontation and then repeated ara-aytakum hypotheticals.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies one root across observation, confrontation, and counterfactual inquiry; I infer a deliberate expansion of seeing into disciplined reasoning, while the alternative is that these are ordinary independent uses without a shared epistemic program.

changed_reading.before: Tara asks only whether the eye detects a crack.
changed_reading.after: Tara inaugurates a mode of inquiry that joins observation to consequence-testing and counterfactual reasoning about what is not immediately visible.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's form-distant s-m-m target for the quranic s-m-w root and must not be paraphrased as though samawat lexically meant apertures. It remains anchored to samawat, repeated seeing, and futur, and is useful only as a qualified material analogy that changes the scale of the search from obvious rifts to pinhole-sized breaches.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Samawat at word 4 stands between measured creation and the command to search it for futur.

activation_trace.role: A narrow aperture through which something enters supplies a deliberately form-distant image of the smallest possible breach.
Opening and splitting anchor the aperture analogy to the anomaly the ayah actually names.
Repeated eye-and-insight inspection turns the tiny breach into a limit case for detection.

changed_reading.before: The challenge asks only for a large visible crack.
changed_reading.after: As an exploratory material analogy, the challenge presses inspection down to the scale of a pinhole: no breach, however narrow, resolves the search.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because futur most directly activates opening and splitting, whereas this model carries the same f-t-r root's origination branch. It remains anchored by the doubled kh-l-q and the layered object, but downstream prose should present it as a secondary overlay, not a replacement translation: the visible order does not expose disconnected seams of beginning.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The ayah repeats creation around a layered plurality and closes by asking for futur.

activation_trace.role: Origination and beginning recast a sought fissure as a visible seam where one layer appears to begin independently of the whole.
Bringing creation into existence anchors the origination overlay in the ayah's repeated creation language.
Multiple superposed layers provide the interfaces at which separate beginnings might have shown.

changed_reading.before: No physical crack is visible between layers.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, no layer displays an autonomous seam of origin; plural beginnings are visually integrated into one creation.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain activation is surprising because 67:30's ayn denotes flowing water, not the eye, and ghawr describes water withdrawing into depth. It remains relevant through the shared eye branch, the focus's basar and repeated seeing, and the surah's closing inquiry; prose must qualify it as an analogy for evidentiary access, never as lexical equivalence.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus sends sight back to make a hidden structural defect present, while the final ayah asks who can bring deeply withdrawn water back as a flowing source.

activation_trace.role: Descent into depth supplies an inaccessible hidden domain from which evidence would need to emerge.
The seeing eye supplies the deliberately cross-domain bridge back to the focus's visual instrument.
A flowing water source supplies the image of hidden reality becoming accessible at the surface.
The eye as commanded instrument anchors the source analogy to the focus ayah.
Repeated seeing is treated as the attempt to bring any hidden rupture into evidentiary presence.

changed_reading.before: Sight passively receives whatever lies on the cosmic surface.
changed_reading.after: As a contained analogy, returned sight seeks to make hidden structure yield evidence like a source bringing inaccessible depth to the surface.

strongest_changes: The ayah's perfection became measurable interface integrity rather than generic beauty or homogeneity.
The returned gaze became a repeatable falsification procedure that also tests and eventually exhausts the observer.
Later turbulence and bird flight separated coherence from stasis and recast it as actively held coordination.
Later sight-language expanded the visual challenge into direct observation, consequential confrontation, and counterfactual reasoning.
summary.what_was_special: The focus ayah unusually joins a concrete layered object, explicit defect criteria, a repeated observation root, an imperative rerun, and the name al-Rahman, allowing engineering, epistemic, and care-based mechanisms to reinforce without being merged.
remaining_uncertainties: The hell scene may revise the meaning of cosmic integrity or may function only as a contrast to the ordered heavens.
Reading mercy as maintained non-separation is well anchored in the divine name but still depends on a reader-supplied relational arrow.
The pinhole, origination-seam, and hidden-source readings depend on form-distant or cross-domain branches and should remain explicitly exploratory.
